sites.counter_mechanism: Per-rank arrival counter array (pace_dev with PTX red.release.gpu.global.add.u32 / ld.acquire.gpu.global.u32 on single GPU, pace_tokens with PTX st.release.sys.global.u32 / ld.acquire.sys.global.u32 across GPUs); ggml_cuda_ar_copy_add signals on compute stream and Stage 1 spins on send stream for call k-2; host never blocks (GGML_CUDA_AR_COUNTER_SYNC_LEGACY=1 restores host wait).
sites.reason: Two-back pacing enforced stream ordering only and guarded no host buffer; replaced with device-side arrival counters.

sites.counter_mechanism: Mapped pinned rendezvous counters (ce_tok) updated with PTX st.release.sys.global.u32 and polled with PTX ld.acquire.sys.global.u32 + __nanosleep(100) across devices with zero host waits.
sites.reason: Cross-card staging and scratch reuse handshakes in captured copy-engine AllReduce use device-side arrival counters.

sites.counter_mechanism: Cache-line-spaced arrival ring (p->arrival) with __threadfence_system() release stores and per-device monotonic token counters (p->counter[i]); zero host waits.
sites.reason: Small and chunked cross-GPU reductions and gathers already synchronize exclusively through device-side arrival counters.

sites.counter_mechanism: Device-memory arrival counters (arrival_counters SLOT_FORK and SLOT_JOIN) with PTX red.release.gpu.global.add.u32 producer and ld.acquire.gpu.global.u32 consumer spin on uncaptured eval; captured graphs use zero-overhead CUDA graph DAG edges (GGML_CUDA_COUNTER_SYNC_LEGACY=1 restores stream events).
sites.reason: Multi-stream fork-join within a graph evaluation enforces GPU-to-GPU ordering only.

sites.counter_mechanism: Device-memory arrival counters (arrival_counters SLOT_L2_FORK and SLOT_L2_JOIN) with PTX red.release.gpu.global.add.u32 / ld.acquire.gpu.global.u32 on uncaptured eval, plus device-side l2_issue_stop atomic stop word; captured graphs use CUDA graph DAG edges.
sites.reason: Side-stream L2 issuer and expert L2 tensor-prefetch warm fork-join enforce ordering only.
